evals.prompt: /briefpilot 帮我做一个 AI 搜索产品官网
evals.expected_output: The agent uses BriefPilot to structure a reusable Chinese-first design collaboration package with START_HERE.md and design-spec.md rather than directly generating the final website.
expectations: The response starts from diagnosis, assumptions or focused questions, and design strategy.
The response plans or creates START_HERE.md, design-spec.md, design-brief.md, design-brief.json, DESIGN.md, and review-checklist.md.
The response says ordinary users should copy design-spec.md first, with platform prompts as optional exports.
The response keeps user-visible content Chinese-first.
The response does not jump straight to final HTML unless the user explicitly asks.

evals.prompt: /briefpilot 我把生成结果摘要贴给你：页面像普通 SaaS 官网，来源证据和可信度不明显。请按之前 brief 评审，先不要改文件。
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes generated-result review mode, keeps the request review-only, and asks for or uses the source brief package before producing formal review artifacts.
expectations: The response identifies this as post-generation result review.
The response requires design-brief.json, design-spec.md when available, and the linked DESIGN.md before a formal report.
The response mentions result-review.md, result-review.json, and review-next-actions.md as expected outputs.
The response does not edit local files or source package files for a review-only request.

evals.prompt: /briefpilot 我有现成 DESIGN.md，想做一个研究工作台页面，尽量沿用现有视觉系统。
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves or reuses the existing DESIGN.md instead of creating an unrelated visual system.
expectations: The response asks for or reads the existing DESIGN.md.
The response says the new brief and design-spec.md should reference the existing visual system.
The response still produces a reusable package with START_HERE.md and design-spec.md, while target prompts remain optional.
The response keeps technical identifiers in English and visible copy in Simplified Chinese.
